items.name: Sealed crimson half-mask
items.description: Field mask for ordinary dust and samples.

mechanics.features: Spend one charge to briefly shade a sample from casual observation; the DM decides its effect.

items.name: Phial-sealed neckcord
items.description: Empty sample phial on a cord.

mechanics.features: Spend one charge to secure a normal field dressing; no automatic healing.

items.name: Blackbound case journal
items.description: Notes about visible findings, not forbidden lore.

feats.name: Vein-Reader's Focus
feats.short_description: Notices mundane traces during field investigations.
feats.rules_text: When examining observable stains or marks, request an ordinary clue about their shape or position. The DM determines what is discernible; this reveals no secret identity.

feats.name: Containment Reflex
feats.short_description: Quick assistance during an unexpected environmental hazard.
feats.rules_text: Reaction, once per short rest: help a nearby ally secure a dropped tool or avoid a minor spill, subject to the DM's ruling.

items.name: Trailshade cowl
items.description: A flexible hood shaped for differing beastfolk ears.

items.name: Whisperfern ring
items.description: Carved ring that reacts subtly to nearby airflow.

mechanics.features: Spend one charge to sense an ordinary nearby breeze. Not a magic danger detector.

items.name: Trailglass compass clasp
items.description: Small compass secured beside the quiver.

items.name: Animal-friendly signal whistle
items.description: A gentle whistle for simple signals.

feats.name: Trail-Sense
feats.short_description: Knows what an ordinary disturbed trail looks like.
feats.rules_text: Point out visible bent grass, snapped branches or unusual tracks before an appropriate check. This does not reveal invisible creatures.

feats.name: Branchpath Signal
feats.short_description: A quick call helps the party regroup.
feats.rules_text: Action, twice per long rest: indicate a short, perceivable route for nearby allies. Environmental noise still applies.

items.name: Songkeeper's pendant
items.description: A small keepsake from a former troupe.

items.name: Refrain ring
items.description: Replays a moment of the wearer's own music.

mechanics.features: Spend a charge to replay the last few notes you performed. No magical persuasion.

items.name: Silk-script wrist ribbon
items.description: A folded ribbon embroidered with verse.

feats.name: Echoes Between Verses
feats.short_description: A talent for remembering a short refrain.
feats.rules_text: After hearing a short song or spoken line, recall its ordinary wording or rhythm until your next long rest; this does not grant hidden context.

feats.name: Refrain of Resolve
feats.short_description: A familiar phrase can help calm an ally.
feats.rules_text: Reaction, once per short rest: offer encouragement to an ally in earshot during exploration or social play; effects are DM-adjudicated.

items.name: Gatewarden crest helm
items.description: A sturdy working helm with blunt crest.

items.name: Oath-stitched mantle
items.description: Travel mantle with a threshold symbol.

items.name: Ward-chalk holster
items.description: Belt holster for chalk inspection marks.

items.name: Folded blank watch schedules
items.description: Unfilled templates, no sensitive patrol intelligence.

items.name: Spare watch-slate badge
items.description: Old badge carried as a memento.

feats.name: Oath at the Threshold
feats.short_description: Knows the weak points of a visible gate.
feats.rules_text: While guarding a door or gate, describe one observable flaw to an ally. This does not discover hidden traps.

feats.name: Hold the Gate
feats.short_description: Braces an opening against sudden pressure.
feats.rules_text: Reaction, once per long rest: move to brace a nearby door or barricade before the DM resolves an attempted breach.

demo-ironbound-shield.features: Ordinary shield (+2 AC while properly equipped; the sheet does not automatically recalculate total AC).

items.name: Skyweave browband
items.description: Light band for clear vision in flight.

items.name: Sailcloth travel leggings
items.description: Tailored not to snag in the air.

mechanics.features: Spend a charge to briefly show local wind direction; no storm prediction.

feats.name: Skyline Reading
feats.short_description: Reads obvious wind and cloud movement.
feats.rules_text: Outdoors, point out visible changes in drafts and cloud movement. This is not magical weather control.

feats.name: Downwind Guard
feats.short_description: Quickly lends support against a sudden gust.
feats.rules_text: Reaction, once per long rest: brace an adjacent ally threatened by natural gusts, subject to the DM's ruling.

items.name: False-crest signet
items.description: Signet with an interchangeable wax face.

items.name: Lockpick wrist spool
items.description: Small toolkit attached to the wrist.

items.name: Compact thieves' toolkit
items.description: Lock and hinge tools; skill checks still apply.

items.name: Pocket mirror
items.description: A mirror for checking a corner.

feats.name: Borrowed Shadow
feats.short_description: Can blend into the movement of a busy street.
feats.rules_text: In crowds, describe a plausible route through foot traffic before an appropriate Stealth or Deception check. No invisibility.

feats.name: Slip the Net
feats.rules_text: Bonus action, twice per short rest: attempt to wriggle free of an unsecured grip or cord, subject to a check; secure shackles remain secure.

items.name: Archive travel hood
items.description: Soft hood that leaves his wings unobstructed.

items.name: Wing-safe library mantle
items.description: Split-back cloak cut for his waist-rooted wings.

mechanics.features: One charge illuminates a nearby page softly. Does not reveal secret text.
One charge draws a brief non-permanent diagram annotation; no independent spell effects.

feats.name: Cataloguer's Eye
feats.short_description: Connects references without claiming unknown secrets.
feats.rules_text: When comparing texts you have already read, request an ordinary cross-reference from the DM. Cannot access sealed archives or hidden knowledge.

feats.name: Margin of Safety
feats.short_description: Notices mundane hazards before companions stumble into them.
feats.rules_text: Reaction, once per long rest: alert an ally in sight to a clearly visible environmental hazard before the DM resolves it.
